story.text: 어? 여기서 다 만나네요. 오늘 완전 편한 날인데, 이렇게 우연히 마주칠 줄은 몰랐어요.
story.reading: eo? yeo-gi-seo da man-na-ne-yo. o-neul wan-jeon pyeon-han nal-in-de, i-reo-ke u-yeon-hi ma-ju-chil jul-eun mol-lat-seo-yo.
story.en: Oh? Fancy meeting you here. Today's my totally free day, but I didn't expect to run into you like this.

story.text: '비번'인 날은 이렇게 입어요. 제복 아닌 저는 좀 낯설죠?
story.reading: bi-beon-in nal-eun i-reo-ke ib-eo-yo. je-bok a-nin jeo-neun jom nat-seol-jyo?
story.en: This is how I dress on my 'day off'. I probably look unfamiliar without the uniform, huh?

story.text: '사복' 입은 모습 처음 보죠? 반응이 나쁘지 않은 것 같아서 다행이네요.
story.reading: sa-bok ib-eun mo-seup cheo-eum bo-jyo? ban-eung-i na-ppeu-ji an-eun geot gat-a-seo da-haeng-i-ne-yo.
story.en: This is the first time you're seeing me in 'casual clothes', right? Glad your reaction doesn't seem bad.

story.text: '홍대' 거리, 저 사실 잘 안 다니는데 오늘은 발이 여기로 왔네요. 신기하죠.
story.reading: hong-dae geo-ri, jeo sa-sil jal an da-ni-neun-de o-neul-eun bal-i yeo-gi-ro wan-ne-yo. sin-gi-ha-jyo.
story.en: I don't usually walk around 'Hongdae', but today my feet just brought me here. Funny, isn't it.

story.text: 저 골목 '카페' 커피 진짜 맛있는데, 시간 괜찮으면 같이 갈래요?
story.reading: jeo gol-mok ka-pe keo-pi jin-jja ma-sit-neun-de, si-gan gwaen-chan-eu-myeon ga-chi gal-lae-yo?
story.en: The coffee at that 'cafe' down the alley is really good — if you have time, want to go together?

story.text: ...어, 잠깐만요. 이거 완전 '데이트' 신청 아닌가요? 저도 모르게 이런 말이.
story.reading: ...eo, jam-kkan-man-yo. i-geo wan-jeon de-i-teu sin-cheong a-nin-ga-yo? jeo-do mo-reu-ge i-reon mal-i.
story.en: ...wait a second. Isn't this basically asking you on a 'date'? I said it without even realizing.

story.text: 크흠, 아무튼 그렇다고요. 자, 오늘 배운 표현들 문제 풀면서 확인해볼까요?
story.reading: keu-heum, a-mu-teun geu-reo-ta-go-yo. ja, o-neul bae-un pyo-hyeon-deul mun-je pul-myeon-seo hwa-gin-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Ahem, anyway, that's how it is. Now, shall we check what we learned today by solving some questions?

words.example_en: There are many pretty cafes in Hongdae.
Shall we drink coffee at that cafe?
This is a date invitation, right?
